scope: Owner approved 75 and rejected 25 from the 100-word batch. Only the 75 approved senses enter revision 26; all rejected spellings are excluded from required answers, variants and bonuses.
sourceAttribution: Wiktionary contributors: fixed revision links and short adapted glosses under CC BY-SA 4.0. Georgian explanatory dictionary, Linguistic Technologies Group: source URLs and checked content hashes; short editorial glosses only. No full dictionary definitions are copied into the proposal.
selection: Prioritize compatibility with unused approved words and familiar short nouns. Every candidate has a regenerated five-answer draft with four already approved partners, seven wheel tiles, at least two five/six-letter answers and the existing connected-grid, density and phone-size gates.
limitations: Drafts are independent and cannot all be assumed to fit together under campaign-wide spacing, unique-wheel and chapter-pacing rules.
Unused-partner counts describe tested opportunities, not guaranteed campaign coverage or a forecast of reduced repetitions.

No rare filler, plural noun, conjugated verb, excluded action form or owner-rejected spelling is intentionally proposed. Borderline meanings and participial lexical senses are recorded individually for review.
The finite search is not a proof of global optimality or native-speaker review.
